interactions.note: The epitope of Fab4A03 on the angiotensin II type 2 receptor, in complex with ligand [Sar1, Ile8]AngII (1Sar-Arg-Val-Tyr-Ile-His-Pro-Ile8, was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. A construct, AT2R-BRIL(ICL3), was used that encoded AT2R lacking the N-terminal glycosylation sites and the putative C-terminal palmitoylation site (residue range: 35–346) and in which the 243SYG245 sequence in the third intracellular loop (ICL3) was replaced with thermostabilized apocytochrome b562 (BRIL).; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.2 angstroms

The epitope of Fab4A03 on the angiotensin II type 2 receptor, in complex with endogenous ligand angiotensin II (AngII), was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. An AT2R construct (residue range: 35–346) was used designed by truncating the N-terminal glycosylation sites with thermostability-improved apocytochrome b562 (mBIIG) and truncating the putative C-terminal palmitoylation site.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.2 angstroms
